# aoss_interface (Resource)

Manages a single physical port's interface configuration block: its name and shutdown state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aoss_interface" "uplink" {
  interface = 24
  name      = "OPTIMUX-TIE"
  shutdown  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (Number) The interface (port) number, between 1 and 255.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name to assign to the port; empty for the default (no configured name).
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Whether the port is administratively shut down.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
